Everything else hosted under vote/sheets/ (closed decision records, superseded drafts, pre-vote triage pipelines) is logged as a regen queue, never a fail. A sheet hosted with current csl-pyutil passes by construction — register it under 'live' in the SAME pass that hosts it (the /review-sheet Phase 3-bis step), and drop the entry the moment its vote applies.
